name: context-relay
description: Hands the work to a fresh session before a long context degrades the model, and carries on there.

threshold.title: Relay at (% of context window)
threshold.description: When a turn ends with the context at least this full, relay to a fresh session.

tokenCeiling.title: Relay at (tokens)
tokenCeiling.description: Also relay once the context holds this many tokens, whatever the window. 0 turns it off.

hardThreshold.title: Stop a running turn at (%)
hardThreshold.description: Mid-turn, after a tool finishes with the context at least this full, stop the turn and relay. 0 turns it off.
